name: quality_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 3-minute EMA (EMA-36) diverges above the 10-minute EMA (EMA-120) AND the gap is actively widening over the prior 30 seconds, this signals large institutional TWAP/VWAP programs are accumulating at multiple timescales simultaneously — not just a brief noise spike but a sustained directional program. The EMA gap acceleration distinguishes a live institutional order from a decaying imbalance: if each successive 5-second bar is adding to the gap, the program has not finished. A 5-minute ROC above 15 bps confirms the move has macro follow-through across the prior 60 bars. The VWAP position filter ensures the trade aligns with the session's dominant order flow direction, filtering entries where spot has already overshot.
core_signal_oneliner: 3-min EMA crosses above 10-min EMA and gap is actively widening over 30 seconds, confirming institutional program still running
